messages.content: Build a complete single-file HTML Snake game with a canvas, arrow-key controls, score, restart button, and responsive styling.
I’ll make one self-contained index.html with a centered canvas, fixed-step loop, collision checks, food spawning, score display, and restart flow.
Add WASD controls and prevent page scrolling while playing.
Added WASD aliases and preventDefault for arrows/WASD; reverse turns are rejected and hidden tabs pause safely.
Create a polished one-file Snake game with neon colors, a high-score display, and localStorage persistence.
The single HTML file includes a dark neon canvas, current/best HUD, accessible buttons, and guarded localStorage. Food never appears under the snake.
The best score should update immediately and survive refreshes.
Best updates on food collection and loads on initialization; malformed storage falls back to zero.
Make a complete Snake game in one HTML file designed for phones, with touch buttons and a pause button.
A responsive canvas, four large touch controls, pointer events, and pause/resume provide a mobile-ready game with aria labels and touch-action:none.
On mobile, swiping the canvas should also turn the snake.
Added 24px-threshold swipe detection choosing the dominant axis; taps still work.
Write a standalone Snake game with wraparound walls, increasing speed, and a game-over overlay.
The game wraps coordinates at edges, lowers the tick interval after food with a safe minimum, and draws a restartable game-over overlay.
The speed increase jumps too much.
Speed now decreases by 8ms per food to a 70ms floor, with current speed shown in the HUD.
Build a classic single-file Snake game where hitting a wall ends the run, with a visible grid and start screen.
The file provides a start overlay, crisp grid, arrow/WASD controls, wall/self collision, and deterministic reset state.
Add Enter to start or restart, and Space to pause.
Added a state machine: Enter starts/restarts, Space toggles pause during play, and buttons mirror both actions.
Create a complete Snake game in one HTML file with obstacles, levels, and a score multiplier for consecutive food.
Rectangular wall blocks advance every five foods, food avoids obstacles, and a combo window raises the multiplier shown beside score.
The first level feels unfair when an obstacle spawns beside the snake.
Generation reserves a 5x5 safe zone around the initial snake and retries overlapping placements.
Make a minimal but complete canvas Snake game with a settings panel for board size and speed.
One HTML file exposes board dimensions and speed presets in a dialog; applying settings resets the run and preserves best score.
Do not let a resize make the canvas blurry.
The renderer uses devicePixelRatio: CSS controls layout while the backing canvas is scaled to logical grid units.
Build a one-file Snake game with a retro CRT look, keyboard controls, pause, and a countdown before each new game.
The file draws scanlines and vignette, supports arrows/WASD, and runs a 3-2-1 countdown before movement; pause freezes simulation.
The countdown should not accept accidental direction presses.
Direction input is queued during countdown and applied only when play begins; the latest queued turn wins.
Create a polished single-file Snake game with normal, golden bonus, and poisonous fruit.
Each fruit has type, color, lifetime, and score effect; golden gives five points and poison ends the run. The HUD explains symbols.
Make poison less frustrating by warning before it expires.
Poison pulses during its final two seconds and shows a warning marker before replacement.
Write a complete accessible Snake game in one HTML file with high contrast, reduced-motion support, and screen-reader status text.
The game includes high-contrast colors, focus rings, a live status region, and a reduced-motion branch that removes decoration.
Announce food and game over, but not every tick.
Announcements are event-driven for food, pause/resume, and game over; movement stays silent.
Build a Snake game as a single HTML file with a leaderboard of local runs and name entry after game over.
Top five JSON scores live in localStorage; names use textContent and ties sort by earliest submission.
Add a guest default and let Escape close the name form.
The form defaults to Guest, trims to 12 characters, and Escape submits the default when empty.
Make a complete Snake game with a slow-motion power-up, wall collisions, and a pause control.
A blue power-up halves tick rate for six seconds; a timer bar shows duration, and walls remain lethal.
Pause should also freeze the power-up timer.
The timer advances from the same simulation clock as movement, so pause freezes both.
Create a single-file Snake game supporting keyboard, touch, and gamepad input, with a daily challenge seed.
Arrows/WASD, swipes/buttons, and the Gamepad API are supported; a date seed creates a shared daily food sequence.
Gamepad polling uses too much CPU when idle.
Polling starts only after connection, stops on blur/game over, and samples at 15Hz.
Build a stylish Snake game in one HTML file with portals, wraparound edges, and combo score.
Paired portal cells teleport the head while preserving direction; edges wrap and food chains within four seconds multiply score.
Prevent a portal exit from immediately teleporting back.
Teleport marks the head portal-locked for one movement and excludes the destination until the next step.
Write a self-contained Snake game for embedding: no dependencies, responsive layout, score, pause, restart, and configurable walls.
One dependency-free HTML file has scoped styles, responsive canvas, score/best, controls, and a Walls toggle for lethal or wraparound edges.
Add a share button that copies the final score without failing on insecure contexts.
The button uses Clipboard API when available and a textarea execCommand fallback, reporting status without blocking restart.
